coverage.text: Every functional requirement has at least one invariant, one task and one gate row. Every invariant appears in a task.

terminology.text: The model's words are used throughout: reject, retract, fold, deposit, tip, obligations. Window names follow the constitution's retraction row: processing window, retraction window, after the windows. "Phase 1/2/3" appears only where existing code and tests use it.

ambiguities-left-open.text: Whether merging this repair is itself held by the consumer conflict, or only the consumer-integration claim is. The constitution holds the affected claim; the parent decides which.
